articles.title: Chainalysis-led operation flags 7,700 accounts in child abuse probe
articles.description: Operation Lighthouse generated 14,300 investigative leads across 11 crypto exchanges and payment services and flagged over 7,700 suspect accounts.

articles.title: India plans first tokenized bonds using wholesale CBDC: Report
articles.description: India plans to test tokenized corporate bonds in a September pilot, with state-controlled REC issuing the debt and select investors using wholesale CBDC payments.

articles.title: Shipyard winds down IPFS work after Protocol Labs ends funding
articles.description: The funding loss leaves InterPlanetary File System software without dedicated maintainers and puts the future of key public services in Protocol Labs’ hands.

articles.title: Bitcoin RSI bullish divergence draws 2022 comparisons as analysis weighs new price trend
articles.description: Bitcoin price analysis eyes the potential end of its current macro downtrend based on weekly RSI signals.

articles.title: Thailand moves closer to Bitcoin, Ether ETFs with draft rules
articles.description: Thailand’s SEC opened consultations on local Bitcoin and Ether ETF rules and qualification standards for foreign digital asset custodians.

articles.title: Standard Chartered becomes first bank distributor of HKD stablecoin
articles.description: The bank plans tokenized money market fund settlements in the fourth quarter as HKDAP expands its phased rollout into conventional banking.

articles.title: Galaxy puts Coldcard hack losses at 1,789 BTC, with 87% unmoved
articles.description: Galaxy Research’s latest tally shows that more than half of 221 Coldcard hack victim reports involved individual losses exceeding 1 Bitcoin.

articles.title: Business owner faces up to 280 years over $24M crypto Ponzi scheme
articles.description: A federal jury convicted Brent Kovar of wire fraud, mail fraud and money laundering after he took $24 million from at least 400 investors.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs add $338M as six-day inflow streak hits $2.26B
articles.description: Bitcoin ETFs have drawn $2.26 billion over six trading days, while year-to-date net outflows have narrowed to about $2.57 billion.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: US targets Iran’s crypto sector, cites over $100M in oil-linked payments
articles.description: The US Treasury expanded sanctions to Iran’s digital asset sector, alleging a UAE-based broker processed over $100 million in crypto for oil sales.

articles.title: BNB Chain activates Pasteur hard fork to strengthen bridge security
articles.description: BNB Chain activates the Pasteur hard fork on BSC, closing bridge and validator security gaps while targeting greater transaction capacity.

articles.title: Korean bank taps Ripple for payments, Pakistan opens crypto licensing: Asia Express
articles.description: Asia’s biggest crypto hubs are locked in a tax-cut arms race, while Ripple will help Korea’s Jeonbuk Bank move money across borders.

articles.title: CFTC, US soldier accused of illegal Polymarket bet spar over interpretation of prediction markets
articles.description: A judge stayed the CFTC’s civil case against a soldier who allegedly used nonpublic information for a Polymarket bet, but the regulator is trying to weigh in on the criminal case.

articles.title: Gemini plans to distribute crypto prediction markets through Apex brokerages
articles.description: The proposed deal would make Gemini the exclusive venue for crypto event contracts offered through Apex’s FCM, expanding its prediction-market reach to brokerage clients.

articles.title: Bernstein sees new USDC growth cycle, sets $140 Circle price target
articles.description: USDC supply increased by roughly $2 billion in seven days, with Bernstein citing higher transaction activity and several factors that could support further growth.

articles.title: Coinbase-affiliated advocacy group endorses candidates for US midterms
articles.description: With just over two months until the US general election, Stand With Crypto announced its pick for politicians in its efforts to “elect the most pro-crypto Congress in history.”

articles.title: Coinbase tokenized stocks go live on Base with Chainlink price feeds
articles.description: Coinbase’s B20 equities bring stocks including Apple and Nvidia onchain, allowing eligible non-US users to trade them 24/7 and use them across DeFi.

articles.title: Bitcoin price hits $80K as 24-hour crypto short liquidations pass $220M
articles.description: As BTC tops $80,000 for the first time since May, price analysis warns that the market still needs to sustain higher levels to challenge the bear-market thesis.

articles.title: Strive buys 1,110 Bitcoin for $81.5M, holdings top 21K BTC; ASST shares surge 11%
articles.description: Strive’s Nasdaq-traded shares surged more than 11% as the Bitcoin treasury company said it paid an average of $73,409 per BTC, pushing its holdings to 21,356 Bitcoin.

articles.title: Crypto advocacy groups oppose Illinois digital asset tax in court
articles.description: Following a similar lawsuit filed by the Digital Chamber in July, two digital asset advocacy groups challenged Illinois’ 0.2% crypto tax on constitutional and due process grounds.

articles.title: Bitmine extends 14-month ETH buying pace as Ether breaks above $2.5K
articles.description: Ether’s breakout above $2,500 has put the spotlight back on corporate ETH treasuries, with Bitmine now nearing its long-stated accumulation target.

articles.title: Zondacrypto boss seeks leniency for testimony on political ties: Report
articles.description: Przemysław Kral reportedly faces a fraud charge and is cooperating with Polish prosecutors as estimated customer losses reach $650 million.

articles.title: Bitget CEO isn’t buying the Bitcoin rally — She’s waiting for $50K
articles.description: Bitget CEO Gracy Chen doesn’t believe the current Bitcoin rally is sustainable, and she aims to buy more BTC around the $50K mark later in 2026 or early next year.

articles.title: Strategy launches $1.6B cash pool after $2B common shares raise, maintains hold on BTC buys
articles.description: Strategy held off on new Bitcoin buying, maintaining holdings at 840,447 BTC as it launched a $1.59 billion cash pool after raising $2 billion from MSTR stock sales.

articles.title: Japan’s SBI leads $68M Fasset round at $1B valuation
articles.description: Fasset raised $68 million in a Series C led by SBI Group as the companies plan a digital bank in Malaysia and to expand stablecoin payments.

articles.title: First bear-market trend line reclaim since 2025: Five things to know in Bitcoin this week
articles.description: Bitcoin closed a weekly candle above its 50-week EMA for the first time since late 2025 as markets prepared for the Jackson Hole symposium.

articles.title: ECB defends digital euro privacy as CBDCs face global scrutiny
articles.description: Piero Cipollone said the Eurosystem would not identify digital euro users as central bank digital currencies face privacy concerns worldwide.

articles.title: Germany widens MiCA lead as latest EU register update adds 6 banks
articles.description: Germany expands its lead in EU MiCA authorizations with 79 crypto asset service providers, ahead of France and the Netherlands.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows hit $1.9B in strongest week since October 2025
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs attracted $1.92 billion last week, their strongest weekly inflow since October 2025, as Bitcoin briefly climbed above $78,000 on Friday.
